_comment: Example no-code model-swap config. Copy to config/ai.json (gitignored) to pick a default model without touching any source file. An explicit ANTHROPIC_MODEL / ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL env var always wins over this file; leaving a field null/absent falls back to the caller's or SDK's own default. Values may be native Anthropic model ids (e.g. "claude-sonnet-5") or upstream gateway slugs (e.g. "anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6" via Vercel AI Gateway).
